title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go, parity fixes and v1.70.0 bumps
author: Avery Chen
description: This PR unifies authentication retries and streaming ergonomics across the three official SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go), applies parity bugfixes discovered during integration testing, and bumps SDK versions to v1.70.0. Motivation: customers expect identical retry semantics and a consistent streaming developer experience across languages; previous discrepancies caused user confusion and a small class of production errors (token duplication on reconnects and inconsistent retry backoff). Changes include: 1) common retry policy contract and instrumentation hooks; 2) finalized streaming helper APIs (async iterator helpers in Python, readable stream interface in TS, channel-based convenience wrapper in Go) with identical reconnection and idempotency semantics; 3) auth token refresh plumbing standardized (background refresh with single-flight in each SDK to avoid token thrash); 4) parity fixes found in cross-SDK spec (preserve original request metadata on retry, consistent error codes); 5) docs and changelogs updated, tests extended. Checklist: - [x] implement retry policy and token refresh across SDKs; - [x] stabilize streaming helpers and add E2E tests; - [x] update docs and migration notes; - [x] bump versions to v1.70.0 and tag release; - [x] run cross-language integration matrix and fix parity regressions. Related: Linear ENG-1423, ENG-1487. CI matrix: linux/mac/windows for all SDKs, python 3.10-3.12, node 18/20, go1.20/1.21. See commits and changed files for details.

a7c9e12: python-sdk: add StreamingAsyncIterator helper; implement single-flight token refresh; update docs

review_comments: Priya Singh (reviewer): Overall looks great; two requests: 1) can we expose BackoffConfig in TS for advanced tuning? 2) add an integration test that simulates intermittent 401s and validates single-flight refresh?
Avery Chen (author): Answered; exposed BackoffConfig in TS and added the requested integration test in python and ts. Updated docs with example usage for BackoffConfig.
Marco Alvarez (reviewer): Found a race in Go token refresh under high concurrency; suggested switching to a sync.Once-per-token key with in-memory lock map.
Avery Chen (author): Addressed Marco's comment, replaced naive mutex with per-key single-flight implementation and added stress test.
merge_outcome: merged via squash merge by Priya Singh on 2026-02-25 (commit e9f1a2d). Release v1.70.0 tags pushed to sdks/* repos.
release_notes: Stable: unified auth retry semantics and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; token refresh single-flight to avoid auth thrash; streaming helpers improved for reconnect and idempotency; several parity bugfixes; SDKs bumped to v1.70.0. Migration: update any custom retry/backoff integrations to use exposed BackoffConfig or the new RetryPolicy interface.
additional_notes: This PR fixed parity issues reported during internal integration testing and during a customer incident (SUP-887). No database or infra migrations required. We should monitor SDK telemetry for increased 401 refresh rates for one week post-release and roll a patch if regressions observed.
